titulo: Housing, town and finding your way: Looking for a flat

aula.titulo: Housing, town and finding your way
aula.objetivo: Look for and rent an apartment (rent, floor, deposit), give and understand directions with several landmarks, and describe a neighborhood with its pros and cons.

blocos.titulo: Renting an apartment, step by step
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: in ads, the «Kaltmiete» is the rent WITHOUT utilities; the «Warmmiete» includes water, heating and building fees. STEP 2: the «Kaution» is the security deposit, usually up to three months of «Kaltmiete». STEP 3: the floor — watch out, this is different from American English: «im Erdgeschoss» (on the ground floor = US first floor), «im ersten Stock» (on the first floor = US second floor), «im zweiten Stock», «im dritten Stock». After «in» + Wo?, the dative ordinal takes «-en». STEP 4: useful questions: «Ist die Wohnung möbliert?» (Is it furnished?), «Wie hoch ist die Kaution?» (How much is the deposit?), «In welchem Stock liegt die Wohnung?», «Gibt es einen Aufzug?» (Is there an elevator?), «Ab wann ist die Wohnung frei?» (When is it available?). STEP 5: asking permission: «Darf man Haustiere halten?» (Are pets allowed?) STEP 6: closing the deal: «Ich nehme die Wohnung» (I'll take the apartment).
